validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="a">
  <state id="a">
    <onentry>
      <send event="ping" eventexpr="'ping'" delay="1s" delayexpr="'2s'"/>
    </onentry>
    <transition event="ping" target="b"/>
  </state>
  <final id="b"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: send event name cannot use both `event` and `eventexpr`
notes: each `<send>` property (event, target, type, delay, and the send ID as `id` or `idlocation`) has one literal and one computed form; supplying both is ambiguous

diagnostics.message: send delay cannot use both `delay` and `delayexpr`
notes: each `<send>` property (event, target, type, delay, and the send ID as `id` or `idlocation`) has one literal and one computed form; supplying both is ambiguous
